text:
maya: Heads-up — new canary run for Orbit9b (int4) is hitting OOMs during long streaming responses. Repro steps: spawn 30 concurrent streams with max_new_tokens=1024. Logs show allocation failures when KV cache grows.
kevin: saw it. pattern = high max_new_tokens + batching coalescing long sequences -> fragmentation.
oliver: runtime trace: 
```
[E] alloc failed: 67108864 bytes
[E] kv_cache_grow seq_len=1024 slots=2048
[E] slab_free_count=17420 small_slot_avg=4096
[E] -> OOM fallback
```
ciara: does Orbit9b have reserve slots set?
maya: default reserve_slots=1. not enough for int4 ephemeral kernel temps.
jen: two levers: reduce default max_new_tokens for this model, and increase reserve_slots. also consider enabling experimental KV compaction to defragment.
kevin: propose changes on canary: default_max_new_tokens=256, reserve_slots=3, batch_window_ms=6 (was 12). enable kv_compaction flag.
ciara: agree. plus add adaptive per-route cap so short-chats don't pay. make model default conservative.
oliver: batching note: large microbatches (>8 examples) seem to increase contiguous allocation demand. we should limit microbatch_size to 6 for orbit9b.
maya: action items: 1) set model default max_new_tokens=256 2) reserve_slots=3 3) microbatch_cap=6 4) turn on kv compaction for canary 5) test with stress plan below.
kevin: applying canary patch now:
```
nctl apply model-config orbit9b --set default_max_new_tokens=256 --set reserve_slots=3 --set batch_window_ms=6 --set microbatch_cap=6 --set kv_compaction=on
```
jen: note: kv_compaction uses extra CPU during compaction passes. should be fine on canary. might add small CPU tail latency. monitor closely.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 1759943245 by kevin
ciara: stress plan: (A) 5k short requests (avg new=40), (B) 200 long requests (new=900), (C) mixed concurrency 60. capture mem curves, slab fragmentation, eviction_count.
maya: success criteria: zero OOMs in 1h stress and 95p latency <= 1.3x baseline, plus no quality regressions on 200 eval prompts.
oliver: fallback policy: if OOMs > 2 in 5m, shift 30% traffic to orbit7b via routing rule.
kevin: canary looks healthier so far. one allocation warning at 13:07 but didn't escalate.
maya: if compaction doesn't fix, fallback plan is to implement periodic slab trim on idle (`malloc_trim(0)`) which reclaims free pages into the kernel. may add small jitter.
jen: trimming might spike tail p99 for a moment. try compaction first.
kevin: monitoring dashboard shows eviction_count down 40% and avg alloc latency smoother. will report final after 30m. :mag:
